clue.text: Game slower? I cry, a little put out

indicators.note: the small sample is stretched or put out around the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: a taster is a little sample of something
a mew is a cat's cry

explanation.surface: A frustrated player complains that a slow opponent is spoiling the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' acts as a container signal: the little sample is stretched out round the cat's cry and I. 'Game slower' is a player stalling, not a lazy sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who deliberately slows a game down is wasting the clock, a description with a question mark because it is playful.

clue.text: Band member neighbour upset

explanation.definitionFit: A tuba is a large brass instrument played in a brass or military band.

clue.text: Parasite in power, say?

clue.text: King requiring line in red or white, one choosing shoe

clue.text: One entertained by short routine -he shouldn't complain

clue.text: Communist changing sides retaining purpose for causes

an end is an aim or purpose

clue.text: Capital squandered, faces day of ill-omen

clue.text: Record about military engagement needing no introduction as a reference

clue.text: Wasp, perhaps, gobbling me up, good sweetmeat

clue.text: Co-operate with instructions on a Christmas cracker?

clue.text: Plotters out to catch alumnus in main trap

explanation.definitionFit: A cage set on the seabed to catch shellfish is a trap for the main, an old poetic word for sea.
